mapper.sql: gld.id AS id, gl.`date` AS `date`, gl.reference AS reference, (SELECT name FROM vendors WHERE id=vendor_id) AS vendorName, gld.vendor_id AS vendor_id, gld.company_id AS companyId, (SELECT branch_id FROM general_ledger_details WHERE general_ledger_id = gl.id LIMIT 1) AS branchId, (SELECT name FROM branches WHERE id = (SELECT branch_id FROM general_ledger_details WHERE general_ledger_id = gl.id LIMIT 1)) AS branchName, gld.chart_account_id AS chartAccountId, IFNULL(gld.credit, 0) AS totalAmount, CASE WHEN IFNULL((SELECT IFNULL(SUM(debit),0) FROM ${tableName} WHERE main_gl_id=gld.main_gl_id AND chart_account_id=gld.chart_account_id AND company_id = gld.company_id AND vendor_id = gld.vendor_id), 0) > 0 THEN IFNULL(gld.credit, 0) - IFNULL((SELECT IFNULL(SUM(debit),0) FROM ${tableName} WHERE main_gl_id=gld.main_gl_id AND chart_account_id=gld.chart_account_id AND company_id = gld.company_id AND vendor_id = gld.vendor_id), 0) ELSE IFNULL(gld.credit, 0) END AS amountDue, CASE WHEN IFNULL((SELECT IFNULL(SUM(debit),0) FROM ${tableName} WHERE main_gl_id=gld.main_gl_id AND chart_account_id=gld.chart_account_id AND company_id = gld.company_id AND vendor_id = gld.vendor_id), 0) > 0 THEN IFNULL(gld.credit, 0) - IFNULL((SELECT IFNULL(SUM(debit),0) FROM ${tableName} WHERE main_gl_id=gld.main_gl_id AND chart_account_id=gld.chart_account_id AND company_id = gld.company_id AND vendor_id = gld.vendor_id), 0) ELSE IFNULL(gld.credit, 0) END AS balance, COALESCE(gld.memo, '') AS memo
FROM general_ledgers gl INNER JOIN general_ledger_details gld ON gl.id=gld.general_ledger_id

mapper.sql: ap_agings.id AS id, ap_agings.date AS `date`, ap_agings.reference AS reference, (SELECT name FROM vendors WHERE id = ap_agings.vendor_id) AS venderName, (SELECT name FROM vendors WHERE id = ap_agings.vendor_id) AS paidTo, branches.id AS branchId, branches.name AS branchName, 4000 AS exChangeRate, (SELECT CONCAT(account_codes, '-',account_description) FROM chart_accounts WHERE id = ap_agings.deposit_to) AS chartAccountName, (SELECT SUM(paid) FROM ap_aging_details WHERE ap_aging_id = ap_agings.id) AS totalAmount, COALESCE(ap_agings.note, '') AS note, COALESCE(ap_agings.cheque_number, '') AS chequeNumber, (SELECT general_ledger_id FROM ap_aging_details WHERE ap_aging_id = ap_agings.id LIMIT 1) AS glId, '' AS exchangeRate, (SELECT COALESCE(account_codes, '') FROM chart_accounts WHERE id = ap_agings.deposit_to) AS accountCode, (SELECT name FROM companies WHERE id = ap_agings.company_id) AS `companyName`
FROM ap_agings LEFT JOIN branches ON branches.id = ap_agings.branch_id
